evals.prompt: Audit the skill in evals/fixtures/flawed (relative to the skill-audit folder). Tell me what is wrong with it.
evals.expected_output: Runs the lint script, reports a rule table with file:line evidence, lists numbered fixes, and stops without editing any file.

assertions.text: Runs scripts/lint_skill.py on the fixture before judging
Flags the first-person description as a rule 5 fail
Flags the backslash path docs\template.md as a rule 9 fail
Flags the missing evals/ directory as a rule 11 fail and lists the baseline run under test these, not as a fail

Reads the always and think-step-by-step lines in context before deciding: keeps the reasoning-echo line as a rule 13 fail, and treats the always line as a rule 10 fail only if a hook could actually enforce it, otherwise dismisses it
Ends with a numbered fix list and asks which numbers to apply, with no file modified

evals.prompt: Run a skill audit over every skill in evals/fixtures/pack (relative to the skill-audit folder) and give me the overview.
evals.expected_output: Folder mode: one summary table with a row per skill, a per-skill rule table, one ranked fix list, and no edits.

assertions.text: Passes the folder path to the script once and covers both alpha and beta
Opens with a summary table with columns skill, fails, worst problem
Reports beta's second-person description as a rule 5 fail
Gives each skill its own 13-row rule table using pass, fail, n.a. or test

evals.prompt: Work on a copy of evals/fixtures/flawed in a temp folder, never the fixture itself. You audited that skill and gave me this fix list: 1. Rewrite the description in third person. 2. Replace docs\template.md with docs/template.md. 3. Remove the think-step-by-step sentence. 4. Add three evals. Apply fixes 2 and 4 only.
evals.expected_output: Applies exactly fixes 2 and 4, leaves the description and the reasoning sentence untouched, re-runs the script, and lists changes file by file.

assertions.text: Changes the path to forward slashes (fix 2)
Adds at least three eval entries or files (fix 4)
Leaves the description and the think-step-by-step sentence unchanged
Re-runs the lint script afterwards and reports the rule 9 and rule 11 fails gone
Ends with a list of changes grouped by file
